sections.title: About this notice
sections.text: This notice describes the current website. It is a draft pending confirmation of Esgrow Studio’s legal business identity, address and privacy contact before accepting online inquiries.

sections.title: What the forms do
sections.text: If you submit an inquiry and the server confirms receipt, your name, email, optional business details, chosen service, message and consent are stored in the studio’s configured MongoDB database so the studio can review and respond. Downloading a brief instead creates a local file without submitting it. Avoid entering sensitive personal information.

sections.title: Hosting and external resources
sections.text: The hosting provider may process technical request information to serve and protect the site. The website loads fonts from Google Fonts, which involves a request to Google. Provider terms and privacy notices also apply to those services.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
sections.text: No analytics or advertising trackers have been added to this website. See the cookie policy for the current browser-storage behaviour.

sections.title: Your information
sections.text: You can clear unsent entries by refreshing or closing the page, and delete downloaded briefs from your device. For submitted inquiries, the studio must provide a verified contact for access, correction and deletion requests before accepting commercial inquiries. A retention period has not yet been finalised and must be set before launch.

sections.title: Changes
sections.text: This notice should be reviewed whenever forms, analytics, integrations or hosting arrangements change.

sections.title: Draft website terms
sections.text: These are general draft website terms. Esgrow Studio’s registered business details, governing law and contact information must be confirmed before these terms are relied on for commercial engagements.

sections.title: Information on this website
sections.text: The site introduces services and creative concepts. Descriptions are general and do not create a binding offer, service-level commitment or guarantee of business outcomes.

sections.title: Projects and proposals
sections.text: A separate written agreement must set out deliverables, fees, taxes, payment milestones, timelines, revisions, third-party costs, intellectual property, cancellation and support arrangements before work begins.

sections.title: Portfolio projects
sections.text: Portfolio case studies describe work delivered by Esgrow Studio. Project scope and qualitative outcomes are based on the studio’s project accounts. Website captures and product imagery show the public project experience and do not independently verify commercial results. Linked websites may change after a capture. Third-party names and marks belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: Using the site
sections.text: Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorised access or use its content in a way that infringes another party’s rights. Access to third-party services remains subject to their own terms.

sections.title: Project brief downloads
sections.text: Submitting an inquiry or downloading a brief does not form a service contract. No payment is accepted on this website. Inquiry delivery depends on the availability of the configured backend and database.

sections.title: Questions and updates
sections.text: The legal business identity, verified privacy contact and a retention and deletion schedule must be confirmed before commercial launch. Project-specific questions should be resolved in the written proposal and agreement.

sections.title: Current website behaviour
sections.text: This website does not set analytics, advertising or preference cookies through its application code. It does not use local storage to save your project form.

sections.title: Essential service behaviour
sections.text: The hosting and sign-in infrastructure may use essential technical mechanisms outside the application code. Check the hosting provider’s notices for its own data handling.

sections.title: External fonts
sections.text: Google Fonts is requested to display the website’s typeface. That request exposes technical connection information to the provider.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can manage cookies and site data using your browser settings. No optional application cookies are currently offered. This policy must be reviewed before adding analytics or advertising integrations.

sections.title: Our approach
sections.text: We aim for clear navigation, readable content and usable experiences across screen sizes. Accessibility is part of ongoing design and development rather than a one-time task.

sections.title: Features on this website
sections.text: Navigation and forms use semantic HTML, interactive controls have visible focus styles, and animations respect the reduced-motion setting. Touch and keyboard scrolling retain native behaviour.

sections.title: Motion preferences
sections.text: Enable reduced motion in your device or browser preferences to disable entrance effects and wheel momentum. You can navigate using a keyboard without using a mouse.

sections.title: Known limitations
sections.text: The site has not undergone an independent accessibility audit. Some decorative text and generated imagery may need further review. This statement is not a claim of certified compliance.

sections.title: Feedback
sections.text: A verified business contact channel for accessibility feedback must be added before public commercial launch.
